Kadence pod 160 kroků za minutu. Nižší k: Cadence below 160 steps per minute. At the same pace, a lower cadence means a longer stride and more load on the knee and hip with every step: raising cadence by 5–10 % reduced it in the laboratory (Heiderscheit et al., 2011). In high-school runners with a cadence below 166 steps per minute, shin injuries were more frequent (Luedke et al., 2016). That a low cadence by itself predicts injury has not yet been reliably shown, however, and 160 is the app's working threshold. Cadence also falls at slower paces. If you want to raise it, add at most 5–10 % and ideally discuss it with a physiotherapist.
